meta.what: A derivation, not an upstream file: CMS Hospital General Information joined to HIFLD's hospitals (FEMA RAPT copy) by exact normalised street address + 5-digit ZIP, attached only where exactly one row on each side shares the key and the two are not a tenant and another facility (refusedTenant). Keyed by HIFLD ID.
meta.source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Hospital General Information (Provider Data Catalog xubh-q36u); HIFLD hospitals via FEMA RAPT
meta.credit: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, Care Compare (Hospital General Information)
meta.licence: no licence stated (metastore license: null); US federal work
meta.joinRule: key = address upper-cased, every non-alphanumeric to a space, words abbreviated by ADDRESS_WORDS (STREET to ST, NORTH to N, ...), then '|' and the first five digits of the ZIP; attached only where exactly one CMS row and exactly one HIFLD row (any status) share the key; a house-number-only key is not used; rows still unattached then get a second pass on mailFreeKey (a box or drawer after PO, P O or POB removed, and a bare BOX or DRAWER n after a street removed, but kept on either side of a rural-route marker (RR, R R, HC, HCR, RFD, RD, RT, RTE, ROUTE, RURAL ROUTE, STAR ROUTE/RT n); U S as US; ordinal street words as numbers), attached only where that key is unique across all rows and neither row is already attached or refused; a one-to-one match is refused when tenantConflict finds a tenant marker in the HIFLD name only (and CMS does not type its own row Long-term), or conflicting types with names that do not agree (a distinct part, D/P, is never refused on types); facility names and types are read for that test only: no row stores either, and meta.refusedTenant stores, per refused pair, the HIFLD ID, the CCN and a reason naming the tenant marker word or the HIFLD TYPE and CMS hospital_type, never a facility name
